content.title: This county is known as “China's Santorini”, and this fishing village is hailed as “the most beautiful” in China. China Daily reporter Dylan Walker, drawn by his youthful connection to #Fujian, traveled to Dongshan county and visited Aojiao village. There, he immersed himself in the lives of fishermen and explored the stories of the villagers, who were inspired by the vision set out by President Xi Jinping. #RuralVitalization | Hola Fujian | Facebook
